correctness.rationale: For the exact (Z/4)^2 graph models, the definition F in Dom(G) iff no closed neighborhood N[v] lies in F matches complement domination. Independent reconstruction enumerated all 2^16 masks: Shrikhande has 59,818 nonempty faces; rook 59,746. Exact vertex-toggle Morse matching on every nonempty face gives respectively 29,903 and 29,871 paired cover relations; complete directed-Hasse topological sorts consume all 461,552 and 460,656 incidences, leaving critical cells (0:1,9:11) and (0:1,9:1,11:2). Forman then yields the Shrikhande integral wedge of 11 nine-spheres, but only rook integral H_9=Z and H_11=Z^2; higher rook attachments are deliberately undecided. Inspecting the entire verify.py and its JSON certificate, and an independently coded complete face-poset and character reconstruction, establishes the 192-element affine graph group (12 local linear maps times 16 translations) and traces: character sum 0, square sum 576, so invariants 0 and irreducible multiplicity-square sum 3. The latter entails a multiplicity-free sum of three distinct complex irreps, not an integral representation classification.
